description: Use this when several icons are needed as files, with every `hash` from `search_assets`, in one call. Not for a single icon (`download_asset`). `colors` takes HEX codes or CSS named colors, not `currentColor`. Next: when building a project, fetch `downloadUrl`, unzip it and save the files there. Never link `downloadUrl` from project files: it expires. Export multiple icons (up to 50) as PNG or SVG, bundled into one .zip. Returns JSON with a single short-lived `downloadUrl`, `expiresAt`, `expiresInSeconds`, `mimeType` ("application/zip"), `fileName`, and the `iconHashes` it contains. All icons share the same render options. Give the user `downloadUrl` as a clickable link labelled with `fileName`, and tell them it expires in 2 hours; do not report a failure because you cannot fetch it yourself. Clients that can fetch files may GET `downloadUrl` directly (no API key needed) and unzip it. SVG-only params: `responsive`, `strokeToFill`.

colors.description: Array of HEX codes or CSS named colors.

iconHashes.description: Icon IDs (hashes) from `search_assets` results, one per array element (max 50).

responsive.description: SVG only. Scales with container (viewBox, no fixed size).

strokeToFill.description: SVG only. Convert strokes to fills (strokeWidth ignored).

name: download_multiple_assets
title: Download multiple assets
